capex_override.ack_reason: Out-of-band by construction: the engine has no filed capex value to band against (last filed value is null under every candidate tag in all periods of companyfacts), so any value flags out-of-band. The $0 is not an estimate — it is proven by the filer's own FY2025 10-K cash-flow statement, which contains no capex line and reconciles exactly without one in FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025.
capex_override.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every candidate tag the engine reads because, as an Agency mortgage REIT holding financial assets (Agency MBS), AGNC buys no property or equipment and reports no capital-expenditures line; its cash deployment (purchases of Agency securities) is an investing activity for the MBS portfolio, and it carries no property-and-equipment line on the balance sheet (engine ppe_net blank every year). The filing's own cash-flow reconciliation proves the capex amount is $0, not an undisclosed purchase (NLY/AFG/EG-style proof). The engine's history already carried capex as assumed-zero, so the override changes no OE figure — it converts a silent zero-fill into a sourced, registered decision.
capex_override.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-23, accession 0001423689-26-000043), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: the investing-activities section lists only purchases and sales/maturities of investment securities and related portfolio flows — there is no purchases-of-property-and-equipment or any capital-expenditures line for FY2025, FY2024 or FY2023, and the balance sheet carries no property-and-equipment line. The statement fully reconciles without one (this run's statements.json, filing-direct): FY2025 operating $653M + investing -$25,864M + financing $25,182M = the reported net change in cash of -$29M exactly; FY2024: $86M - $11,169M + $11,083M = reported $0 exactly; FY2023: -$118M - $14,672M + $14,227M = reported -$563M exactly. EDGAR companyfacts for CIK 1423689 contains no capex fact under any candidate tag in any period (statements.json warning: no capital-expenditure figure filed for 67 periods with operating cash flow).

moat_against: No pricing power: Agency MBS spreads and repo funding costs are market-set; the assets are commodity government-guaranteed securities anyone with financing can buy

Structural leverage (~7.4x tangible equity at Q2 2026, company reporting) makes book value hostage to rate and spread moves — tangible book per share has eroded over the long run despite the recent recovery
Persistent equity dilution: diluted share count +24.0%/yr CAGR in the engine history (ATM issuance funding portfolio growth), so per-share spread income barely grows even when the portfolio does
ROE is cyclical and sign-flipping (-15.1% in FY2022, +1.9% FY2023, +8.8% FY2024, +13.5% FY2025, fundamentals.json) — no through-cycle return on capital above the cost of equity is demonstrated

Earnings quality: GAAP net income is dominated by non-cash mark-to-market on the MBS book and hedges (other non-operating +$1,122M in FY2025, statements.json), and the $0.12/month dividend has been held flat at $1.44/yr since 2020 while book value per share fell
moat_for: Scale and liquidity: one of the two largest Agency mREITs ($97.2B investment portfolio at Q2 2026), with deep, preferred access to repo funding and the TBA/dollar-roll market
Internally managed — no external-manager fee drag — with an operating history since 2008 through multiple rate cycles

Demonstrated accretive capital raising: ATM issuance at premiums to tangible book value (Q2 2026: $167M raised at ~$10.31/share vs $8.58 tangible book) grows per-share book when the shares trade above book
Pure Agency portfolio (94% 30-year fixed Agency MBS/TBA at Q2 2026): no credit risk in the asset book — losses come from rates/spreads, not defaults
moat_justification: Weak: AGNC's only durable advantages are scale in the Agency MBS market ($97.2B portfolio at Q2 2026), deep repo/TBA market access, internal management and the ability to issue ATM shares accretively when the stock trades above tangible book. The product itself is a commodity — government-guaranteed securities funded at market repo rates — so there is no pricing power and no switching cost. Measured returns confirm no franchise premium: fundamentals.json roic_proxy is null for every year (no operating-income tag is filed) and gross margin is not meaningful for a spread lender, while ROE swung from -15.1% (FY2022) to +13.5% (FY2025) — rate/spread-driven, not franchise-driven. Same grade as peer NLY (3/10).
